heading: What to watch for (red flags — call today, don't wait)

items.text: You soak a pad every hour, or clots the size of a golf ball or bigger.
Bleeding that had eased and suddenly comes back heavy.
Severe headache, changes in vision, chest pain, trouble breathing.
Severe belly pain, or the wound looks red, hot or has pus.
Thoughts of hurting yourself or the baby — call 988 or the 1-833-TLC-MAMA line (1-833-852-6262), free, confidential, 24/7, in Spanish and English.
